title: Accountant
description:
We are currently supporting a U.S.-based company in hiring an Accountant. The Accountant is responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations with a strong emphasis on Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and financial accuracy. This role plays a critical part in maintaining the financial health of the organization by ensuring timely processing of payments, accurate recordkeeping, compliance with accounting standards, and effective follow-up on receivables


Process accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions accurately and in a timely manner

· Perform account reconciliations to ensure financial records are accurate and up to date

· Prepare and assist with journal entries, financial statements, and accounting reports as needed

· Utilize accounting software (including Zoho Books) for data entry, reconciliation, and reporting

· Maintain compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and applicable internal controls (including SOX-related practices)

· Contact customers with open receivables and perform consistent follow-up on past-due invoices until payment is received

· Maintain and reconcile customer accounts, ensuring balances, credits, and payments are applied correctly

· Research unapplied cash and credit memos to determine proper application or refund

· Send customer invoices and statements of account

· Pull and review daily payment details from bank portals

· Maintain third-party invoicing and payment portals

· Collaborate with internal team members to resolve discrepancies and improve accounting workflows

· Perform other accounting-related duties as assigned

Qualifications & Requirements

Remote Work & Workspace Requirements

· Ability to work in a fully remote environment

· A private, quiet workspace suitable for handling confidential financial information and conducting professional phone calls

· Reliable high-speed internet connection sufficient for cloud-based accounting systems and web portals

· Ability to maintain focus, organization, and productivity while working independently

Technical & Computer Skills

· Basic to intermediate computer proficiency, including:

o Use of a Windows 11 device that meets company security standards

o Willingness to allow company-managed security settings on the device

o Ability to work across multiple web-based systems and portals simultaneously

title: Accountant
description:
We are currently supporting a U.S.-based company in hiring an Accountant. The Accountant is responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations with a strong emphasis on Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and financial accuracy. This role plays a critical part in maintaining the financial health of the organization by ensuring timely processing of payments, accurate recordkeeping, compliance with accounting standards, and effective follow-up on receivables


Process accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions accurately and in a timely manner

· Perform account reconciliations to ensure financial records are accurate and up to date

· Prepare and assist with journal entries, financial statements, and accounting reports as needed

· Utilize accounting software (including Zoho Books) for data entry, reconciliation, and reporting

· Maintain compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and applicable internal controls (including SOX-related practices)

· Contact customers with open receivables and perform consistent follow-up on past-due invoices until payment is received

· Maintain and reconcile customer accounts, ensuring balances, credits, and payments are applied correctly

· Research unapplied cash and credit memos to determine proper application or refund

· Send customer invoices and statements of account

· Pull and review daily payment details from bank portals

· Maintain third-party invoicing and payment portals

· Collaborate with internal team members to resolve discrepancies and improve accounting workflows

· Perform other accounting-related duties as assigned

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow | Especialista Técnico de Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Analytics Engineer (Pleno)
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores. 28 anos de história e 15x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW). Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um Analytics Engineer (Pleno), confira as informações da vaga:


Descrição da Vaga

Atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de pipelines de dados e soluções analíticas escaláveis , transformando dados brutos em insights estratégicos para o negócio . Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multifuncionais para garantir qualidade, acessibilidade e usabilidade dos dados , promovendo uma cultura data-driven na organização.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar modelagem de dados para atender às necessidades específicas dos times de negócio.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders para compreender demandas e desenvolver produtos de dados (pipelines, indicadores e dashboards) com foco no usuário final.
  • Desenvolver datasets que servirão como fonte única da verdade da empresa , seguindo a arquitetura Medallion (Gold/Diamond) .
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas fontes e plataformas, propondo e implementando soluções automatizadas.
  • Implementar melhorias em processos internos por meio da disponibilização de dados e datasets escaláveis .
  • Atuar como defensor do valor de negócio dos dados , oferecendo orientação técnica e soluções para desafios estratégicos.
  • Construir, manter e evoluir pipelines analíticos com a abordagem de dados como produto , desde o dado bruto até o dado ouro, pronto para consumo por algoritmos e réguas de comunicação.
  • Monitorar a saúde, qualidade e performance da infraestrutura analítica , realizando otimizações contínuas.
  • Desenvolver análises, visualizações, gráficos e dashboards a partir da infraestrutura de dados implementada.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e de infraestrutura em projetos técnicos e evolutivos.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólida experiência na escrita de queries em SQL, Python e/ou R , com foco em performance e escalabilidade .
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados , como Looker, Power BI ou similares.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e analíticos , como BigQuery e Redshift .


Interessou?

Envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte de um time que valoriza técnica, protagonismo e impacto real nas soluções!

title: Merchant Operation
description:
Responsibilities

  • Brand Solutions: Conduct brand research and analysis to deliver comprehensive solutions; establish mechanisms and standards to refine lean business models, ensuring rapid business expansion.
  • Store Operations: Oversee online store operations management and leverage product tools to drive rapid business scale-up; take accountability for the operational results of brand stores.
  • Data & Strategy: Conduct merchant data analysis and performance reviews; timely adjust operational strategies and plans based on data performance, brand feedback, and market dynamics.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Lead collaboration across Offline teams, KA/SMB, User Growth, and Delivery teams; coordinate to achieve the optimal balance between scale, user experience, and P&L for merchant brands.
  • Innovation: Continuously innovate and iterate business models based on market and competitive dynamics; seek solutions that maximize benefits for brands, users, and the platform.

Job Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above; no specific major required.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product operations or merchant operations.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiar with merchant operation processes and rules in the Local Services industry; strong data analysis and problem-solving skills.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication and teamwork skills; ability to effectively manage the team and drive execution.
  • Mindset: Agile thinking, clear logic, and the ability to work under pressure.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Estamos com duas posições abertas para Desenvolvedor Java Sênior, com foco em refatoração e evolução de sistemas. Buscamos profissionais com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento Full Stack e capacidade de contribuir tecnicamente em iniciativas de modernização, melhoria de performance, segurança e escalabilidade.


Responsabilidades

• Atuar em iniciativas de refatoração e melhoria contínua de sistemas legados e/ou em evolução

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend escaláveis, seguras e performáticas

• Construir e manter APIs RESTful com foco em segurança e eficiência

• Contribuir com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, padrões de design e clean code

• Realizar code reviews e apoiar desenvolvedores menos experientes

• Trabalhar em parceria com times de QA, DevOps e demais stakeholders


Requisitos técnicos indispensáveis

• Java 8 ou superior, com domínio de concorrência, multithreading, lambdas e streams

• Experiência sólida com Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security e Hibernate

• Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços

• Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente Oracle e SQL

• Criação e consumo de APIs REST

• Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando JUnit e Mockito

• Git e boas práticas de versionamento, como GitFlow

• Conhecimento em React e ou Angular


Diferenciais

• Experiência com cloud computing, como AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud

• Vivência com ambientes de deploy, monitoramento e escalabilidade em nuvem

• Experiência com bancos de dados não relacionais


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Desenvolvedo(a) Fullstack Sênior - Angular e Java
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedo(a) Fullstack Sênior - Angular e Java para se juntar à nossa equipe na Builders. Quem ocupar essa posição terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais junto a grandes empresas, apoiado por uma equipe colaborativa de tecnologia, designers e gestores.


Se você é apaixonado por desenvolvimento frontend e deseja fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico onde suas habilidades serão valorizadas, queremos você em nosso time para ajudar a criar soluções inovadoras e impactantes!


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (8 ou superior);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Angular (12 ou superior);
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas como MVC, MVVM, Flux e Hexagonal;
  • Experiência com Spring Framework, especialmente Spring Boot;
  • Experiência com modularização de aplicações;
  • Criação e manutenção de testes automatizados;
  • Utilização de Git (Gitflow) e participação em PR reviews;
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful seguras e atuação em arquitetura de microserviços.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Experiência com Angular 17 ou superior;
  • Experiência com Java 21 ou superior;
  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e OracleDB;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de Micro Front-end;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria e AMQP;
  • Experiência com containers Docker e plataformas como Kubernetes e OpenShift.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Active Directory Specialist
description:
Nascida da necessidade do mercado de profissionais de TI e de serviços sob demanda, a HUMATECH atua internacionalmente em todo o continente americano, engajando recursos especializados para posições e projetos de nossos parceiros.


JOB OPPORTUNITY!


Nosso time está procurando um(a) Especialista em ACTIVE DIRECTORY com as seguintes característica:


Responsabilidades:


Administrar, projetar e implementar soluções em ambientes Microsoft 365 e Active Directory;

Atuar em projetos de migração (AD e O365), garantindo segurança e governança de identidade;

Automatizar processos e rotinas utilizando PowerShell;

Colaborar com a equipe no desenho de soluções em Azure, Active Directory,Exchange Online, MS Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive e App Proxy;

Realizar auditorias, troubleshooting e suporte em ambientes complexos.



✅ Requisitos Técnicos:

- 7 a 8 anos de experiência em produtos Office 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, etc.);

- ⁠Domínio em Active Directory, DNS, AD Trusts, ferramentas de migração do AD e Quest;

- ⁠Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento do AD (auditoria, autoatendimento, etc.);

- ⁠Forte conhecimento em PowerShell (gerenciamento e automação);

- ⁠Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de Active Directory e O365;

- ⁠Inglês avançado (capacidade de manter conversação).



➡️ Informações da vaga 


- Tipo de vínculo: Modelo PJ;

- Horário de trabalho: Horário comercial;

- Local de trabalho: Remoto.

title: Salesforce Configuration Specialist
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Salesforce Configuration Specialist to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only) , offering the chance to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


We are seeking a Salesforce Configuration Specialist with strong hands-on experience in complex configurations and data management. This role is focused on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions using declarative tools , with a strong emphasis on Flows, security, and data integrity .


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute advanced Salesforce configurations (Flows, Experience Cloud, automation, custom fields, permissions)
  • Manage data migration and ensure data quality and consistency
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions
  • Troubleshoot configuration and data reconciliation issues
  • Provide training and create user/technical documentation
  • Build reports and dashboards for operational and leadership insights


Required Experience

  • Solid experience with Salesforce administration and configuration (not only certifications)
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • User management (roles, profiles, permission sets, security policies)
  • Data modeling and object relationships
  • Validation rules, formula fields, record types, list views
  • Flows (advanced level) and troubleshooting
  • Experience with SSO/SAML configuration and authentication setup
  • Proficiency in Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and data quality management
  • Ability to differentiate data vs. configuration issues and replicate scenarios in sandbox environments
  • Experience building reports and dashboards


Preferred Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Strong communication skills in English (client-facing environment)
  • Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach
  • Experience in B2B software environments


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, or ISV development
  • Experience writing technical specifications


Why Join

  • Work on international projects with global clients
  • Exposure to complex, large-scale Salesforce environments
  • Collaborative and technically driven team


If you have a strong configuration background and can operate at depth without relying on code, this role is aligned with your profile.

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Nós somos a Bring IT!


Somos uma empresa de serviços profissionais em rápido crescimento e altamente dinâmica, levando transformação digital a clientes em todo o mundo. Desde o lançamento de produtos no mercado até o aumento da produtividade com a tecnologia e os processos certos, o trabalho que realizamos está transformando a maneira como as pessoas trabalham.

Para chegar lá, estamos construindo uma equipe global e diversa, capaz de enfrentar alguns dos desafios mais complexos do nosso tempo. Chamamos essa abordagem única de “360 Success”.


Somos reconhecidos como uma das empresas que mais crescem e têm mais sucesso no ranking Inc. 5000 dos Estados Unidos, e estamos abrindo novos escritórios pelo mundo para continuar crescendo, explorando e diversificando. Com mais de 10 reconhecimentos de parceiros, seguimos expandindo nossa presença nos mercados digitais.

Junte-se ao nosso Dream Team


A equipe Bring IT conta com mais de 300 profissionais espalhados por diversos países. Entendemos que grandes tecnologias começam com grandes talentos e com a diversidade de pensamento.

Nosso negócio é construído sobre conexão, trabalho em equipe e paixão pelo que fazemos. Esses valores moldam nossa cultura todos os dias — e estamos em busca de talentos que queiram gerar impacto no mundo.

Na Bring IT, você pode construir uma carreira gratificante, pois estamos comprometidos em apoiar seu crescimento profissional e pessoal.


Como Engenheiro(a) De Software Sênior, Você Irá

  • Orientar e dar suporte técnico a outros Engenheiros de Software.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento nas atividades do dia a dia.
  • Colaborar diretamente com clientes ou com suas equipes de desenvolvimento, oferecendo orientação e treinamento.
  • Conduzir análise, design, codificação, avaliação, modificação, testes e implementação de scripts e novas funcionalidades no NetSuite ERP.
  • Desenvolver customizações dentro do NetSuite para dar suporte a processos de negócios críticos.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Gerar documentação detalhada de processos, incluindo testes de produto, dados, fluxogramas, diagramas, layouts, comentários de código e outros materiais técnicos.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento NetSuite (scripts, workflows, relatórios).
  • Domínio em JavaScript.
  • Compreensão de arquitetura de sistemas, design orientado a objetos, frameworks web e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle).
  • Proficiência em resolução e tratamento de erros e debugging.
  • Experiência com ambientes de desenvolvimento integrados (IDEs), sistemas de controle de versão, ferramentas de testes unitários e gestão de defeitos.
  • Experiência com Webservices (SOAP e REST).
  • Conhecimento em GIT.


Habilidades e Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência com NetSuite.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação.
  • Graduação em Contabilidade (CPA) é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em consultoria de TI ou de negócios.
  • Proficiência em inglês.
  • Certificações NetSuite.
  • Habilidades funcionais, de implementação e liderança serão consideradas um diferencial.

title: SAP S/4 HANA Finance Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones financieras de SAP S/4 HANA)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


Primary Job Purpose

Manage, support, and assist in the design and implementation of the Financial Accounting and

Controlling template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by

merging business and IT needs, and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and

utilization.


Key Position Accountabilities

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Lead and support the Finance Area in the SAP implementation project from an IT perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects.
  • Should have a strong integration knowledge between FI-SD, FI-MM, FI-PP
  • Should have a strong knowledge Bank master setup, electronic bank statement (EBS) configuration, and cash management.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with a minimum experience of 5 years.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline.

Desirable:

  • SAP Certification in SAP Financial Accounting/Controlling.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: HR and Operations Administrative Support
description:
Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for an HR & Operations Administrative Support (Independent Contractor) . Responsibilities include supporting the employee lifecycle by posting job ads, assisting with hiring processes, preparing and sending contracts, onboarding new agents, managing system access, preparing and reviewing payroll, and supporting workforce performance and attendance tracking.

This role will also assist with performance review coordination, employee relations support, terminations and offboarding processes, and ensuring all system access and tools are properly revoked when contracts end. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while supporting leadership and operations teams.


Qualifications


  • Strong organizational and process management skills
  • Experience supporting HR, recruiting, operations, or administrative functions
  • Experience with onboarding, offboarding, or contract coordination
  • Experience working with remote teams is a plus
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Full Proficiency in English
  • High school diploma or equivalent; HR or administration certifications are advantageous


Requirements =


  • PC or laptop with at least 8GB of RAM
  • At least 200mbps internet speed
  • Headset
  • Dual screen setup
  • At least 3+ years of experience in HR support, recruiting support, administrative, or operations roles
  • Professional English Level


What we will offer you =


  • You will be working as an independent contractor (MEI), providing services between 8am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time
  • You get paid R$ 6k (six thousand brazilian reais monthly)
  • Paid major US holidays


If you believe you are a fit, we highly encourage you to apply now! :)

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Centro-Oeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Centro-Oeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento

title: Risk Control Analyst
description:
Job Responsibilities

  • Investigate and analyze various risk behaviors, including fraud, phishing, and account theft , and take appropriate actions to reduce user losses and improve user satisfaction.
  • Continuously monitor user behavior and prepare investigation reports for identified risk cases.
  • Identify potential risk patterns, maintain a case database , and summarize behavioral characteristics.
  • Detect data anomalies through risk management and real-time monitoring , and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent potential losses.
  • Monitor and manage daily risk control processes to ensure the security and compliance of account activities.
  • Conduct regular reconciliation operations to ensure account balances match actual assets, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Analyze existing risk management processes and policies , and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Facilitate effective communication with internal departments and external partners to ensure timely information flow.
  • Independently handle unexpected issues and propose effective solutions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above .
  • 1–3 years of experience in risk investigation and analysis.
  • Experience in anti-fraud, AML, settlement, or reconciliation in payment institutions, exchanges, banks, or related industries is preferred.
  • Data analysis experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication and written skills , with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Strong logical thinking and analytical ability , capable of breaking down complex data.
  • Fluency in Chinese is required.

Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist – Interventional Cardiology (Brazil)
description:
About us


BrosMed is the largest balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise in China, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment in 2012, the company has grown to over 1,500 staffs in scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide.


Responsibilities


-Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as POT balloons, Wedge NC scoring balloons, and Alveo CTO balloons.

-Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories.

-Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.

-Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning.

-Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion.

-Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals.

-Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy.

-Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up.

-Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards.



Qualifications


Language proficiency:

High-level command of a local language

the ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters).

Industry background:

Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors;

preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs.

Core qualities:

Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven;

strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes;

excellent communication skills and customer service awareness.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (JavaScript / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with comprehensive knowledge of JavaScript to join the software engineering team for our US-based client.

This client saves its customers millions of dollars providing engineering services, consulting, and software for complex, global projects in the renewable energy and oil and gas industries. The clients software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions provide key performance indicators for improved business decision making and workflows enabling inventory management, failure investigation reporting, and change management.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product management, product owner, and key stakeholders to gain approval of proposed architecture development plan
  • Lead the development effort (may include assisting in the hiring and onboarding of additional development and QA resources to assist)
  • Assure that implemented new capabilities meet the needs of the implementation team, customers, and product management
  • Follow common development standards and development methodologies to assure efficiency and high performance
  • Participate in team the code review process
  • Work closely with backend developers to ensure the integrity of the solution
  • Mentor junior developers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of JavaScript software development experience
  • Experience working in a .NET stack
  • Experience working with jQuery, Xamarin, and RESTful APIs
  • Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Ability to perform unit and integration testing for comprehensive code coverage
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies
  • Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
  • A positive attitude always looking to empower the success of others
  • Willingness to take ownership and find ways to unblock oneself
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Knockout or other JS frameworks
  • Experience with PWAs
  • Experience in UI/UX Design
  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: PERM Project Manager
description:
PERM Project Manager


**Please note this is an administrative, non-technical project management role.**


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


This Project Manager will join the PERM Advertising team. The PERM Advertising team provides U.S. immigration-based recruitment advertising and consulting services to U.S. lawyers and law firms.


A PERM Project Manager will support clients with the planning, organization, and execution of advertising projects. This is an administrative, non-technical role focused on scheduling, documentation, communication, and ensuring smooth day-to-day project operations. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, proactive, and skilled at coordinating across teams and stakeholders to keep projects on track.


Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects.
  • Quality assurance functions that involve careful review of documents for accuracy and consistency.
  • Ensure that all projects are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools and techniques.
  • Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders.
  • Manage all lifecycle stages for a project from ideation through sunset, with responsibility for ensuring that deliverables are understood and releases are delivered on time.


Requirements:

  • Proficient in both spoken and written English.
  • Strong educational background.
  • At least one (1) year of professional work experience in an environment that required close attention to detail and high degree of organization.
  • The ability to balance multiple ongoing projects.
  • Clear, effective communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively, as well as with remote teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
